mandatory: Two equal panels side by side with a thin vertical grey divider between them; the agent cards sit in the same positions in both panels
In Before, both agent cards have an amber arrow into the one amber pill 'novasmart-customer-sa'
In After, each agent card has its own green pill directly below it; the grey dashed 'novasmart-customer-sa' pill at the bottom has NO arrows touching it
'novasmart-customer-sa' (twice) and 'promo-agent-sa' are monospace on ONE line inside wide pills; never wrapped or hyphenated
Every label and 'No users left' are semibold near-black ink (#1F2328), never faint grey
The title is bold, large, top-left and on one line
All text is large enough to read when the image is 1000px wide
'Own Agent Identity' sits on ONE line inside its pill
'Personalization agent' may wrap onto two lines only at its space ('Personalization' / 'agent'), the same way in both panels; 'Promo agent' stays on one line
In Before there are exactly two amber arrows, each starting at the bottom of one agent card and ending on the top edge of the amber pill at two different points; the two arrows never join
prohibitions: NO third-party logos and NO Google logo
NO 'Vertex AI', 'Agent Engine', 'reasoning engine' or 'reasoningEngines' anywhere
NO project IDs, NO email addresses, NO 'projects/' paths, NO '@' characters
NO people, faces, hands, silhouettes or characters
NO text that is not listed in text_exact
NO check marks, ticks or crosses
NO arrow crossing between the two panels
NO green in the Before panel
NO red anywhere in the image
NO 'novasmart-' on one line and 'customer-sa' on the next; NO 'promo-agent-' on one line and 'sa' on the next
NO alteration of the identifiers such as underscores, spaces or capital letters
NO third agent in either panel
NO 'Agent' on one line and 'Identity' on the next
NO merged or forked arrow; NO shared arrow trunk
alt_text: The title reads: One shared login became one each. Two panels. Before: Personalization agent and Promo agent, shown as gear icons in blue cards, both have amber arrows into one amber login, novasmart-customer-sa. After: the same two cards, each with a green arrow to its own green pill: Own Agent Identity under the personalization agent, promo-agent-sa under the promo agent. Below, novasmart-customer-sa sits in a gray dashed pill with no arrows, beside the words No users left.
